name: marxopoly
description: Common Ground — a real-time multiplayer property trading board game for the browser.

scripts.build:server: pnpm --filter @marxopoly/shared build && pnpm --filter @marxopoly/server build && pnpm --filter @marxopoly/client build --mode standalone
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @marxopoly/shared build && pnpm --filter @marxopoly/shared test && pnpm --filter @marxopoly/server test && pnpm --filter @marxopoly/client test
